top_strength: Comprehensive logistics probing—Nicole systematically gathered property type, floor count, furniture inventory, special items (piano, workout equipment, appliances), garage details, parking accessibility, and destination house configuration, building a complete picture for accurate pricing.
coaching_note: After the customer declined to book, Nicole sent an email but never held real silence after asking "Would you like our help with your move?"—and later used a throwaway "any questions?" instead of a genuine final-concerns check; these two gaps left money on the table in both commitment moments.
